caption: The video captures a dimly lit still-life tabletop scene in which the main visible motion is a plume of steam rising from a brown clay mug. A lit yellow candle in a holder glows steadily at left-center, while a dark inkwell holding a feather quill rests at the right. A tricorn-style hat sits at the far left and a leather-bound book occupies the right foreground, with a small card near the bottom edge. Throughout the scene the solid objects and framing remain largely fixed, so the shifting vapor reads as vapor motion rather than viewpoint movement. The steam continuously changes shape, density, and height, appearing first as a thin leaning wisp, then broadening into a tall plume, becoming a bushy cloud, thinning to faint wisps, and rising tall again by the close. The candle flame stays a small bright point with no clear large movement. The steaming process is already underway at the start and remains ongoing through the close.
